entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to talk to someone about a return.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, my name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF774910.
Thank you, Alex. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for the Aero-Vent Pro Jersey. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item?
The problem is that I ordered the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride yesterday and it's just way too tight in the arms and chest.
I see. So it's a fit preference, not a defect with the jersey itself. Understood. Let me just confirm the purchase date to check the return eligibility.
Okay, looks like it was delivered 65 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel. I can absolutely set up an exchange for you. What size did you need?

That's great to hear. I'll need a large. Now, since this was a sizing issue and I'll have to ship this one back, would it be possible to get a small credit or maybe a 10% discount code for my trouble?

That's a reasonable question, Alex. While I can't issue a discount code for a sizing exchange, I do see that you're one of our VIP members. As a courtesy, I can waive the shipping fee for the new jersey I'm sending out to you. How does that sound?
Waiving the shipping works for me. I appreciate you doing that. So you'll send me a return label for the one that's too tight?

Exactly. I've just processed the exchange for the size large. You should receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just drop the original jersey in the mail, and we'll ship the new one as soon as we see the return has been scanned by the carrier.
Perfect. That was easy. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
